_doc: Đạo Đồ map for the game (ADR-0004), written by tools/design/dao_do_rework/content/export_game.py from the v5 frozen map and design/dao-do/content/. Do not edit by hand: re-export. Node fields: id, x, y, kind (start, road, small, notable, keystone), name, area (exact | chaos | el:<element> | var:<variant> | border:<a>:<b>, Đạo Đồ rule 4), gate (chaos, rule 3), cluster, grants (a road's purity grants as shares of road_purity), mods [{stat, value, w, scope}] (value before the multiplier; w its price in W), pending [{stat, w, scope}] (lines with no host yet: shown, adding nothing), cap (capability id), effect (its effects.md name), closes (the keystone's closing text). Ids are append-only from this baseline (rule 19).
